title: Requirement
description:
Guiding question: What must Please demonstrably satisfy?

A requirement defines a binding, unambiguous, and verifiable condition concerning the behavior or properties of Please. Requirements describe the agreed product specification independently of implementation progress and validation results. A requirement is binding unless explicitly marked as obsolete.

id.description: Permanent, unique identifier. IDs must never be reused.

name.description: Short, descriptive name of the requirement.

description.description: Defines a binding, unambiguous, and verifiable condition that Please must satisfy. It describes required behavior or properties without prescribing unnecessary implementation details.
examples: Please must support importing external rule sets using immutable Git commit references.

capabilities.description: Capabilities directly related to this requirement.

use_cases.description: Use cases directly related to this requirement.

obsolete.description: Marks a requirement as historical and no longer binding. Omit this property for active requirements.
